# AE Software Solutions LLC

> AE Software Solutions LLC is a compliance-aware operational intelligence consultancy and software and web studio in Chambersburg, Pennsylvania, serving small businesses across the United States. It builds websites, manages online presence, and runs AI follow-up automation for businesses with 5 to 50 employees, often in regulated industries such as mortgage and lending, insurance, and home services. The founder is Anthony Pioquinto. There is no published street address; this is a service-area business and all work is done remotely.

## Services

- [Websites](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/websites/): Custom websites from $495 one time. Starter Site from $495, Lead Funnel Site from $4,500, Custom Platform quoted after a scoping call.
- [Online Presence Management](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/online-presence/): $199 per month. Google Business Profile management, review replies, listing consistency, website care, monthly reporting.
- [Front Desk](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#front-desk): AI receptionist from $99 per month plus a one time $75 setup. $99 up to 60 calls, $179 up to 150 calls, $309 up to 300 calls, $45 per extra 50 calls over 300.
- [Always-On Front Desk](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#front-desk-always-on): $250 per month. Full time AI call answering and follow up.
- [Missed-Lead Audit](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#audit): $250 one time, credited in full toward a first retainer month. Maps every way customers can reach the business and finds where inquiries leak.
- [Launch Package](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#launch): $595 one time. Launch setup for a new online presence.
- [Social Front Desk](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#social-front-desk): $199 per month. Social inbox and comment handling.
- [Total Presence](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#total-presence): $199 per month. Social Front Desk plus Google Business Profile management.
- [Social Management](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/social-management/): $799 per month plus a one time $300 setup. Content, short form video, posting, replies, monthly report. Growth $1,299 per month, Scale $1,999 per month.
- [Creator Packages](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/social-management/): Creator Launch $499 per month, Creator Growth $899 per month, Creator Authority $1,999 per month.
- [Order Desk](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/services/): $149 per month up to 100 orders, $299 up to 500 orders, $549 up to 2,000 orders, $25 per extra 50 orders. Managed AI back office for small B2B sellers: order entry and pricing agents. Setup $150, $295, or $495 by tier.
- [Free Operational Assessment](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/services/): Free. A 10-phase AI-guided discovery interview producing a risk report, compliance register, automation ROI matrix, and roadmap.
- [AI Setup Guides](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/get-started/): $19 per month. Step by step AI setup guides.
- [Branded Document Templates](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/): $295 one time.
- [Contractor Guides](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/guides/): Free. PDF guides for contractors and small service businesses.
- [AI Tools Assessment](https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#audit): $999 one time. Offered only as an add-on to the Missed-Lead Audit, never sold cold.

## Free tools API

Base URL: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/wp-json/aesoftwares/v1/

- POST /rewrite: Rewrite text.
- POST /summarize: Summarize text.
- POST /email: Draft an email.
- POST /transcribe: Transcribe audio.
- POST /tts: Text to speech.
- POST /assessment: Run the free operational assessment.
- POST /marketplace: Marketplace lookup.
- POST /validate: Validate input.
- POST /chat: Chat with the free tools assistant.

## Client dashboard API

Base URL: https://dashboard.aesoftwaresolutions.com/api/v1/

- POST /{service}/events: Post a service event. Per-client Bearer API key required.
- GET /clients/{client_id}/services: List a client's services and status.
- GET /clients/{client_id}/activity: Client activity feed.
- POST /webhooks/telnyx/call-summary: Front Desk call summary webhook.
